questionEnglish: Why might it be dangerous to drive on a poorly-lit street?
questionSomali: Maxay khatar u noqon kartaa in lagu wado waddo iftiinkeedu liito?
optionsEnglish: Pedestrians crossing in a dark area might be difficult to see.
Drivers can only see the traffic in front of them.
Drivers can only see traffic coming against them.
The road surface will always be slippery.
optionsSomali: Dadka lugaynaya ee meel mugdi ah ka gudbaya way adkaan kartaa in la arko.
Darawalku wuxuu arki karaa oo keliya gaadiidka hortiisa yaal.
Darawalku wuxuu arki karaa oo keliya gaadiidka ka imanaya dhanka kale.
Waddadu mar walba way simbiriirixanaysaa.
explanationSomali: Waddo iftiinkeedu liito waxay adkeyn kartaa in la arko dadka lugaynaya, sidaas darteed waa in si taxaddar leh loo wado.

questionEnglish: Why might it be dangerous to drive on a poorly-lit street?
questionSomali: Maxay khatar u noqon kartaa in lagu wado waddo iftiinkeedu liito?
optionsEnglish: It may be difficult to see poorly lit vehicles in dark areas.
Traffic lights will not be working.
Drivers can only see the traffic in front of them.
Drivers can only see traffic coming against them.
optionsSomali: Way adkaan kartaa in la arko gaadiid aan si fiican u iftiimin oo ku jira meel mugdi ah.
Nalalka taraafikadu ma shaqayn doonaan.
Darawalku wuxuu arki karaa oo keliya gaadiidka hortiisa yaal.
Darawalku wuxuu arki karaa oo keliya gaadiidka ka imanaya dhanka kale.
explanationSomali: Gaadiid aan nalal fiican lahayn ayaa ku adkaan kara in la arko habeenkii ama meelaha mugdiga ah.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do if dazzled by the lights of an oncoming vehicle?
questionSomali: Maxaa la sameeyaa haddii nalalka gaari kaa soo horjeeda ay indhaha kaa qabtaan?
optionsEnglish: Look to the left-hand edge of the road and slow down if necessary.
Accelerate to get out of the light quickly.
Flash the oncoming vehicle and move left.
Close your eyes briefly until the vehicle passes.
optionsSomali: Eeg dhinaca bidix ee waddada oo xawaaraha yaree haddii loo baahdo.
Xawaaraha kordhi si aad si degdeg ah uga baxdo nalka.
Nalalka u shid gaariga kaa soo horjeeda oo bidix u leexo.
Indhaha xir muddo gaaban ilaa gaarigu dhaafo.
explanationSomali: Haddii nalalka kaa indho tiraan, eeg dhinaca bidix ee waddada oo si tartiib ah u soco si aad u ilaaliso xakamaynta.

questionEnglish: When should signals be given to other road users?
questionSomali: Goorma ayaa calaamadaha sida indicators-ka loo siinayaa dadka kale ee waddada isticmaala?
optionsEnglish: Clearly and in good time to show what you intend to do.
Only when it is necessary to warn following traffic.
Only when turning at busy junctions.
Only after you have started the manoeuvre.
optionsSomali: Si cad iyo waqti fiican ah si loo muujiyo waxa aad damacsan tahay.
Kaliya marka loo baahan yahay in la digo gaadiidka kaa dambeeya.
Kaliya markaad ka leexanayso isgoysyo mashquul ah.
Kaliya kadib markaad bilowdo dhaqaaqa.
explanationSomali: Calaamadaha waa in la bixiyo si cad oo waqti fiican ah si dadka kale u fahmaan waxa aad samaynayso.

questionEnglish: Is a driver permitted to pick up or set down a passenger on a motorway?
questionSomali: Ma loo oggol yahay darawal inuu rakaab ka qaado ama ka dejiyo motorway?
optionsEnglish: A driver is never permitted to pick up or set down passengers on a motorway.
It is permitted if the driver stops on the hard shoulder.
It is only permitted within 200 metres of a slip road.
It is permitted during daylight hours only.
optionsSomali: Darawal looma oggola inuu rakaab ka qaado ama ka dejiyo motorway.
Waa la oggol yahay haddii uu ku istaago hard shoulder-ka.
Waa la oggol yahay oo keliya meel 200 mitir u jirta slip road.
Waa la oggol yahay oo keliya maalintii.
explanationSomali: Motorway-ga looma isticmaalo qaadista ama dejinta rakaabka, sababtoo ah waa khatar aad u weyn.

questionEnglish: An approaching driver sees a boy on a bicycle saying goodbye to his friend. What should the driver do?
questionSomali: Darawal soo dhowaanaya wuxuu arkay wiil baaskiil wata oo saaxiibkii macsalaamaynaya. Maxaa la sameeyaa?
optionsEnglish: Be prepared for the boy to move off at any moment.
Slow down and beckon the boy to cross the road.
Stop until the boy has moved off.
Proceed normally because the boy is on the footpath.
optionsSomali: U diyaar garow in wiilku dhaqaaqo waqti kasta.
Xawaaraha yaree oo wiilka u tilmaam inuu waddada gooyo.
Istaag ilaa wiilku dhaqaaqo.
Si caadi ah u wad sababtoo ah wiilku wuxuu joogaa footpath-ka.
explanationSomali: Carruurta si lama filaan ah ayay u dhaqaaqi karaan, sidaas darteed darawalku waa inuu diyaar u ahaadaa inuu joojiyo.

questionEnglish: What must a driver be prepared for when children are playing near a ball on the road?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku u diyaar garoobayaa marka carruur ay kubbad ku ciyaarayaan agagaarka waddada?
optionsEnglish: A child could turn back to collect the ball from the roadway.
The ball may burst after the vehicle passes.
The oncoming vehicle may swerve in your direction.
The ball could damage your vehicle.
optionsSomali: Ilmo ayaa dib ugu noqon kara inuu kubbadda ka soo qaato waddada.
Kubbaddu way qarxi kartaa kadib marka gaarigu dhaafo.
Gaariga kaa soo horjeeda ayaa dhinacaaga u leexan kara.
Kubbaddu waxay dhaawici kartaa gaarigaaga.
explanationSomali: Carruurtu waxay si lama filaan ah ugu ordi karaan waddada si ay kubbad u soo qaataan, sidaas darteed waa in si taxaddar leh loo wado.

questionEnglish: When approaching a pedestrian crossing, what should the driver do?
questionSomali: Marka darawalku ku dhow yahay pedestrian crossing, maxaa la sameeyaa?
optionsEnglish: Slow down in good time and be prepared to stop.
Maintain speed because pedestrians have not stepped onto the crossing.
Continue quickly because pedestrians must wait.
Sound the horn to warn pedestrians to stay back.
optionsSomali: Xawaaraha waqti fiican ku yaree oo diyaar u noqo inaad istaagto.
Xawaaraha sii wad sababtoo ah dadka lugaynaya weli ma aysan gelin crossing-ka.
Si degdeg ah u sii wad sababtoo ah dadka lugaynaya waa inay sugaan.
Horn-ka isticmaal si aad dadka lugaynaya uga digto inay dib u joogaan.
explanationSomali: Markaad u dhowdahay pedestrian crossing, waa inaad xawaaraha yareysaa oo diyaar u noqotaa inaad istaagto.

questionEnglish: What should the driver do if there are children playing at the edge of the road?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku sameeyaa haddii carruur ku ciyaarayaan geeska waddada?
optionsEnglish: Reduce speed, drive cautiously and remain ready to brake.
Give a warning signal and drive past at the same speed.
Accelerate and move to the right-hand side of the road.
Drive closer to the kerb to pass them quickly.
optionsSomali: Xawaaraha yaree, si taxaddar leh u wad, oo diyaar u noqo inaad biriig qabato.
Calaamad digniin ah bixi oo isla xawaaraha ku dhaaf.
Xawaaraha kordhi oo u dhaqaaq dhinaca midig ee waddada.
Ku dhowow kerb-ka si aad si degdeg ah u dhaafto.
explanationSomali: Carruurtu si lama filaan ah ayay u geli karaan waddada, sidaas darteed waa in si tartiib ah oo feejignaan leh loo wado.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be conscious of when passing a stopped bus?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ka feejignaanayaa marka uu dhaafayo bas istaagay?
optionsEnglish: People may cross the street at the rear of the bus.
Traffic may only emerge from the street on the left.
The bus may start to reverse.
The bus driver will always signal before moving off.
optionsSomali: Dad ayaa laga yaabaa inay waddada ka gooyaan gadaasha baska.
Gaadiidku wuxuu ka imaan karaa oo keliya waddada bidixda.
Basku wuxuu bilaabi karaa inuu gadaal u socdo.
Darawalka baska mar walba wuu calaamadayn doonaa ka hor dhaqaaq.
explanationSomali: Dadku waxay si lama filaan ah uga soo bixi karaan gadaasha baska, sidaas darteed waa in la feejignaado.

questionEnglish: A silver car is overtaking a parked red car. What should the driver do?
questionSomali: Gaariga silver-ka ah wuxuu dhaafayaa gaari cas oo taagan. Maxaa darawalku sameeyaa?
optionsEnglish: Reduce speed considerably and be ready to stop.
Drive on at the same speed.
Drive on if you do not hit the ball.
Move closer to the parked red car.
optionsSomali: Xawaaraha si weyn u yaree oo diyaar u noqo inaad istaagto.
Isla xawaaraha ku sii wad.
Sii wad haddii aadan kubbadda ku dhicin.
U dhowow gaariga cas ee taagan.
explanationSomali: Marka xaaladdu cidhiidhi tahay ama carruur/kubbad la arko, waa in xawaaraha si weyn loo yareeyaa oo diyaar loo ahaadaa istaag.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be aware of near a pedestrian waiting on a traffic island?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ka feejignaanayaa marka qof lugaynaya ku sugayo traffic island?
optionsEnglish: The pedestrian may leave the traffic island without paying attention.
A tram may move away without warning.
There is no danger because the tram is on rails.
The pedestrian always has priority to cross in front of traffic.
optionsSomali: Qofka lugaynaya wuxuu ka tagi karaa traffic island-ka isagoo aan fiirin.
Tram ayaa dhaqaaqi kara digniin la’aan.
Khatar ma jirto sababtoo ah tram-ku wuxuu ku socdaa rails.
Qofka lugaynaya mar walba mudnaan ayuu leeyahay inuu gaadiidka hortiisa ka gooyo.
explanationSomali: Qofka lugaynaya mararka qaar si lama filaan ah ayuu uga bixi karaa traffic island-ka, sidaas darteed darawalku waa inuu feejignaadaa.

questionEnglish: A driver is following two vehicles and wishes to overtake. What must the driver consider before overtaking?
questionSomali: Darawal wuxuu raacayaa laba gaari wuxuuna doonayaa inuu dhaafo. Maxaa la tixgeliyaa ka hor dhaafidda?
optionsEnglish: The driver’s field of view is not good enough to allow safe overtaking.
The road markings always forbid overtaking here.
The silver car may decide to turn right.
The driver should overtake both vehicles together.
optionsSomali: Aragtida darawalka kuma filna dhaafid ammaan ah.
Calaamadaha waddadu mar walba way mamnuucayaan dhaafidda halkan.
Gaariga silver-ka ah wuxuu go’aansan karaa inuu midig u leexdo.
Darawalku waa inuu labada gaari hal mar wada dhaafo.
explanationSomali: Dhaafid lama bilaabi karo haddii aragtidu aysan ku filnayn in si ammaan ah loo hubiyo waddada hore.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be aware of when approaching a vehicle that is attempting to park?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ka feejignaanayaa marka uu ku dhow yahay gaari isku dayaya inuu baarkimo?
optionsEnglish: The vehicle being parked may move out without warning.
There may be a driveway where the vehicle is parking.
The vehicle may be parking in a loading area.
You may have to stop and assist the driver parking.
optionsSomali: Gaariga la dhigayo wuxuu dhaqaaqi karaa digniin la’aan.
Waxaa jiri kara driveway meesha gaarigu dhigayo.
Gaarigu wuxuu ku baarkimi karaa goob loading ah.
Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad istaagto oo ka caawiso darawalka baarkinka.
explanationSomali: Gaariga isku dayaya inuu baarkimo wuxuu si lama filaan ah u dhaqaaqi karaa, sidaas darteed waa in taxaddar la yeeshaa.

questionEnglish: What should the driver be most conscious of in this situation?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ugu badan ka feejignaanayaa xaaladdan?
optionsEnglish: The pedestrian may suddenly cross the road in front of the vehicle.
The pedestrian always has right of way to cross the road.
No vehicles should be parked on the left-hand side of the road.
One of the parked vehicles may reverse into the driver’s path.
optionsSomali: Qofka lugaynaya wuxuu si lama filaan ah ugu gudbi karaa gaariga hortiisa.
Qofka lugaynaya mar walba xaq ayuu u leeyahay inuu waddada gooyo.
Gaadiid looma oggola inuu dhigo dhinaca bidix ee waddada.
Mid ka mid ah gaadiidka taagan ayaa gadaal ugu soo noqon kara jidka darawalka.
explanationSomali: Dadku si lama filaan ah ayay u goyn karaan waddada, sidaas darteed darawalku waa inuu xawaaraha yareeyaa oo feejignaadaa.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do when travelling behind this vehicle?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku sameeyaa marka uu ka dambeeyo gaarigan?
optionsEnglish: Reduce speed and prepare to stop if necessary.
Overtake the vehicle in front.
Drive as close as possible to the vehicle.
Pass slowly by mounting the kerb on the left.
optionsSomali: Xawaaraha yaree oo diyaar u noqo inaad istaagto haddii loo baahdo.
Dhaaf gaariga kaa horreeya.
U dhowow gaariga sida ugu badan ee suurtagal ah.
Si tartiib ah uga dhaaf adigoo kerb-ka bidix fuulaya.
explanationSomali: Markaad ka dambeyso gaari kale, gaar ahaan mid kaa xannibaya aragtida, waa inaad xawaaraha yareysaa oo diyaar u ahaataa istaag.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be aware of when passing a bus?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ka feejignaanayaa marka uu dhaafayo bas?
optionsEnglish: There may be a car hidden from view in front of the bus.
The bus may be parked at a terminus.
Only buses may use this road.
The bus will always remain stationary.
optionsSomali: Waxaa jiri kara gaari ka qarsoon aragtida oo baska hortiisa yaal.
Basku wuxuu ku baarkimi karaa terminus.
Baska oo keliya ayaa isticmaali kara waddadan.
Basku mar walba wuu taagnaan doonaa.
explanationSomali: Baska weyn wuxuu qarin karaa gaari ama qof kale, sidaas darteed darawalku waa inuu feejignaadaa.

questionEnglish: When driving on a one-way street with vehicles parked on both sides, what should a driver be prepared for?
questionSomali: Markaad ku wadayso waddo one-way ah oo gaadiid ka yaallaan labada dhinac, maxaad u diyaar garoobaysaa?
optionsEnglish: A vehicle door may open on either side of the street.
Oncoming traffic may appear as you overtake the truck.
The truck may be a left-hand drive vehicle.
The road will always become wider ahead.
optionsSomali: Albaab gaari ayaa ka furmi kara dhinac kasta oo waddada ah.
Gaadiid kaa soo horjeeda ayaa muuqan kara markaad truck-ga dhaafayso.
Truck-gu wuxuu noqon karaa left-hand drive.
Waddadu mar walba way ballaaran doontaa hore.
explanationSomali: Marka gaadiid lagu baarkimo labada dhinac, albaab ayaa si lama filaan ah u furmi kara, sidaas darteed waa in la feejignaadaa.

questionEnglish: What should the car driver be aware of in this situation?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalka gaarigu ka feejignaanayaa xaaladdan?
optionsEnglish: The driver should slow down and be prepared to react.
Following traffic may cut the corner.
The road ahead becomes a dual carriageway.
Road marking is taking place ahead.
optionsSomali: Darawalku waa inuu xawaaraha yareeyaa oo diyaar u noqdaa inuu falceliyo.
Gaadiidka dambe ayaa corner-ka goyn kara.
Waddada hore waxay noqonaysaa dual carriageway.
Calaamadeyn waddo ayaa ka socota hore.
explanationSomali: Marka khatar muuqato ama xaalad aan la hubin jirto, darawalku waa inuu xawaaraha yareeyaa oo diyaar u noqdaa falcelin.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be aware of when driving at night along a shopping street with many different light sources?
questionSomali: Maxaa darawalku ka feejignaanayaa marka uu habeenkii ku wado shopping street leh nalal badan?
optionsEnglish: Traffic lights may be difficult to distinguish from other bright lights.
Parking spaces may be difficult to notice.
It is easier to see pedestrians because of the bright lights.
Other vehicles do not need to use headlights.
optionsSomali: Nalalka taraafikada way adkaan kartaa in laga sooco nalalka kale ee dhalaalaya.
Meelaha baarkinka way adkaan kartaa in la arko.
Way fududahay in la arko dadka lugaynaya sababtoo ah nalalka badan.
Gaadiidka kale uma baahna inay isticmaalaan nalalka hore.
explanationSomali: Nalal badan oo kala duwan waxay adkeyn karaan in si cad loo garto nalalka taraafikada, sidaas darteed waa in feejignaan la yeeshaa.
